title: Mage Tower
author: oivoodoo
selftext:
Hello.

Ive just built during 2 hours the game prototype. Ive never done it before with ai tools to be honest and wanted a try.

Used the latest grok and it was actually fun.

Build the prompt and then asked to build  
the demo in basic 3d objects and then in itch found some 3d assets and ask to give a try to use them.

[https://mage.balconygames.com](https://mage.balconygames.com)

Is it playable? what do you think?

Thank you!

comments.author: Legitimate-Base-5333
comments.body:
I tried it out. Was kinda fun! Some random thoughts  
\- On wide desktop screen it was not easy to notice my spells down in bottom right corner.

\- No indication on what the spells actually do? tooltip? show info on other screen?

\- The purple UI/inventory screams AI too much, seems like the default UI all AI provides if not provided other instructions

\- The Wizard boss on wave 5 just insta killed me. Could be skill issue, i dident upgrade defence at all

\- Overall kinda fun, could see me spending 30-60 min playing this, especially if some more polish is done

comments.author: NibiLS
comments.body: What tech stack did you use besides grok?

replies.author: oivoodoo
replies.body:
threejs, python for leaderboard, capacitor to build iOS project as well.  the build size I would say is ok. but it would grow for sure if I continue to add more 3d models there.

comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body:
Nice. Liked it! 

Meteor icon is hard to read. 

Pierce or arcane pierce? Pierce is kinda useless.

How about unique collectable modifiers? 

Finished level 25 and everything is to easy, before balance was good, nearly died in round 8. 

Increase spawn radius for enemies 

Melee enemies never reach the tower 

Clear visuals for different enemy types

Combo system for upgrades

Make elements unlockable or sth you only get from the hero you choose. 

More depth for the hero, it all feels the same

More depth for the different towers, it all feels the same. 

All in all very nice for 2 hours.
